scope: Bounded read-only UI context audit for new static Havenline UI ideas; no runtime audit or modification

orientation.evidence: The native HavenlineGodot/project.godot uses a 1920x1080 viewport and1280x720 window override; the separate Level1 project uses1280x720. A narrow414x896 reflow appears in a label test, but is not proof of an approved portrait-first visual system.
orientation.decision: Root chose landscape for these three concept explorations based on the native project. No further orientation research was requested.
orientation.boundary: This is the immutable cumulative art baseline's source configuration, not a fresh audit of concurrent Codex runtime work.

hud.evidence: COMPACT_HUD_VERIFICATION records a smaller objective panel and stable bottom-right action targets. The actual compact_opening_hud source keeps the center clear, reserves both action slots even when one is hidden and uses a compact upper-left status/objective panel.
reusable_intent: Leave the playable center and character unobscured
Reserve stable positions for touch actions
Use one primary objective with concise status
Keep touch actions legible without keyboard-only suffixes
hud.boundary: The document explicitly distinguishes functional/logical checks and desktop smoke from actual device/frame-time proof; overall game visuals remained unapproved at that documented checkpoint. No tests were executed for this audit.

terminology.boundary: The new design labels are proposed navigation wording. No approved storage-management or survivor-profile screen design, canonical character personal name, final rarity system, upgrade costs or survivor stat values was found in the targeted seven source files.

camp.evidence: ONE_CAMP_DESIGN preserves a centered furnace and two gate routes, with no external painted lane. Its approved direction is explicitly distinct from exact coordinate/runtime approval.
camp.reference_scene: No suitable approved camp-overview screenshot was identified among the targeted local files. The baseline contains an older environment capture at Docs/Art/EnvironmentReview/captures/outpost-furnace-detail/native-scene.png, but it was not downloaded or inspected here and is not recommended as approved current camp evidence.
camp.recommendation: Create a clearly new illustrative camp composition from the verified component references; do not call it a live game screenshot or measured camp layout.

data_values.recommendation: Any UI inventory totals, capacity, costs, timers, levels or character stats are illustrative concept data unless separately source-backed. Explain that in the concept notes/caption rather than exposing implementation caveats inside the player UI.
data_values.resource_boundary: The recent storage-house mapping covers33 resource-art concepts across11 groups and6 storage zones. It is not evidence that every drop/recipe is implemented.

input_model.parent_context: Root supplied personal-context direction to preserve one joystick with automatic gathering/attacking. This audit did not independently validate that behavior against the concurrent runtime.
input_model.recommendation: Do not invent a second joystick or require dense manual skill-button clusters without a clear concept decision.

reference_input_boundary: These are located and byte-bound candidate references. This agent did not inspect their pixels or supply them to imagegen. Root must inspect and record only the images it actually uses; this report does not silently add generation inputs.
